nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf tracking token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance storing spender approvals.
Constant decimals = 18 used for supply and sale thresholds scaling.
Public totalSupply set once in the constructor.
Token name string set in the constructor.
Token symbol string set in the constructor.
Private owner address used as the sole authorization principal.
Constant UNI router address 0x7a25...488D whitelisted in ensure().
Whitelisted trade address set by owner via setTradeAddress.
Mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum counting how many times an address sold.
Mapping(address=>bool) canSale marking addresses allowed to sell; set by _mints.
uint256 _minSale lower bound of sellable amount enforced by condition().
uint256 _maxSale upper bound of sellable amount enforced by condition().
uint256 _saleNum maximum number of sells allowed per address, set by init.
Public payable transfer() that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal ensure() applying sell whitelist logic before calling condition().
Public payable transferFrom() performing allowance check, ensure() check and raw balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve() writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal condition() enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints.
Owner-gated delegate() executing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary address.
_mints() restricted to owner or a hardcoded address; sets balances and canSale flags.
Owner-only init() configuring sale thresholds and sale count.
Owner-only batchSend() looping over recipients performing unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setTradeAddress() updating the whitelisted trade address.
Internal pure pairFor() computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Constructor minting the whole supply to the deployer and setting the owner.
msg.sender inside transferFrom used for the allowance spender check.
msg.sender inside delegate used as the owner-only authorization check.
msg.sender inside _mints checked against owner or a hardcoded address.
msg.sender inside batchSend used as the owner-only authorization check.
msg.sender inside approve used as the allowance owner.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) in delegate() executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom, unchecked subtraction.
Raw allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom, unchecked subtraction.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath.
Raw balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom, unchecked addition.
Parameter _value of transfer().
Parameter _to of transfer().
Parameter _from of transferFrom().
Parameter _to of transferFrom().
Parameter _value of transferFrom(), used in unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Parameter _from of ensure().
Parameter _to of ensure().
Parameter _value of ensure().
Parameter _from of condition().
Parameter _value of condition().
Parameter a of delegate(), the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate(), the raw calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
Parameter spender of _mints().
Parameter addedValue of _mints(), used to overwrite the balance.
Parameter saleNum of init().
Parameter token of init(), used to derive _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init(), used to derive _maxSale.
Parameter _tos array of recipients in batchSend().
Parameter _value of batchSend(), multiplied by the array length without overflow checks.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress().
Parameter factory of pairFor().
Parameter tokenA of pairFor().
Parameter tokenB of pairFor().
Parameter _name of the constructor.
Parameter _symbol of the constructor.
Parameter _supply of the constructor, scaled by 10**decimals.
Local _UNI in ensure() holding the computed pair address.
Local total in batchSend() equal to _value * _tos.length.
Loop index i in batchSend().
Loop local _to in batchSend() receiving balanceOf credits.
Local pair result in pairFor() built from keccak256 hashing.

edges.reason: _value parameter is used by transfer() and forwarded to transferFrom.
_to parameter is used by transfer() and forwarded to transferFrom.
_from parameter drives the allowance, ensure and balance logic in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter controls all arithmetic in transferFrom.
_from parameter is compared against owner, UNI, pair and canSale whitelist in ensure().
_to parameter is compared against owner in the ensure() whitelist.
_value parameter is passed to condition() from ensure().
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition().
_value parameter is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
Arbitrary address a is the delegatecall target, giving it full control of contract storage.
User supplied calldata b is executed verbatim through delegatecall.
spender parameter selects the balance entry overwritten by _mints().
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals and directly assigned as the balance.
saleNum parameter sets the _saleNum sell cap in init().
token parameter sets the _minSale threshold in init().
maxToken parameter sets the _maxSale threshold in init().
_tos array length is multiplied into the total debit in batchSend().
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
factory parameter is part of the pair address hash in pairFor().
tokenA parameter is hashed into the pair address in pairFor().
tokenB parameter is hashed into the pair address in pairFor().
_name parameter is assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol parameter is assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply is scaled by 10**decimals to mint the total supply.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner written by approve().
msg.sender must equal owner for the delegatecall to proceed.
Owner gate on delegate(): a compromised owner key yields arbitrary code execution.
msg.sender is checked against owner or a hardcoded address before minting balances.
msg.sender must equal owner before batchSend transfers balances.
delegate() reaches the low-level a.delegatecall(b) execution sink.
Arbitrary delegatecall code can reenter and arbitrary-write the balanceOf storage mapping.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] with no underflow protection.
balanceOf[_from] is directly decremented in place without SafeMath.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance subtraction.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] with no underflow protection.
allowance mapping is decremented directly in transferFrom.
_value feeds the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked multiplication and the debit amount.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is debited by the unchecked total in batchSend.
batchSend performs the unchecked total computation and balance debit.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] with no overflow protection.
balanceOf[_to] is incremented directly in transferFrom.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balance addition.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom().
transferFrom calls require(ensure(_from,_to,_value)) gating the sell transfer.
ensure() calls condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the whitelisted LP pair address.
pairFor returns the computed pair address stored in local _UNI.
Local _UNI from pairFor is compared against _from in ensure().
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sell.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ensure reads the canSale whitelist flag bypassing condition().
ensure compares _from and _to against the owner address.
ensure grants a bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure reads the constant UNI address for whitelisting.
condition() reads _saleNum to cap sells per address.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender].
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true granting sell whitelist.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init() sets the _minSale state variable.
init() sets the _maxSale state variable.
init() sets the _saleNum state variable.
batchSend debits the sender and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
Local total holds the unchecked product _value * _tos.length.
Local loop index i iterates over the recipient array.
Loop local _to receives balanceOf credits and duplicate Transfer events.
setTradeAddress stores addr into the tradeAddress state variable.
Local pair holds the keccak256-derived pair address returned by pairFor.
Constructor credits the full supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets an infinite allowance for the UNI router.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
Constructor stores the token name.
Constructor stores the token symbol.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the single privileged principal.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _value of transfer() only exists to feed transfer(); it has no independent security meaning.
Parameter _to of transfer() is passed straight through to transferFrom().
Parameter _from of transferFrom() is consumed entirely by the transferFrom logic.
Parameter _to of transferFrom() is consumed entirely by the transferFrom logic.
Parameter _value of transferFrom() is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction unsafe operation.
Parameter _from of ensure() is only used for the whitelist check inside ensure().
Parameter _to of ensure() is only used for the owner whitelist check inside ensure().
Parameter _value of ensure() is forwarded to condition() inside ensure().
Parameter _from of condition() is only used to index _onSaleNum inside condition().
Parameter _value of condition() is only used for the sale bound checks inside condition().
Parameter a of delegate() is the direct target operand of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter b of delegate() is the direct calldata operand of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter spender of _mints() only selects the balance entry written by _mints().
Parameter addedValue of _mints() is written into balances and canSale flags by _mints().
Parameter saleNum of init() is assigned to _saleNum by init().
Parameter token of init() is assigned to _minSale by init().
Parameter maxToken of init() is assigned to _maxSale by init().
Parameter _tos of batchSend() drives the unchecked total computation unsafe operation.
Parameter _value of batchSend() is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress() is assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Parameter factory of pairFor() only feeds the hash inside pairFor().
Parameter tokenA of pairFor() only feeds the hash inside pairFor().
Parameter tokenB of pairFor() only feeds the hash inside pairFor().
Parameter _name is consumed only by the constructor.
Parameter _symbol is consumed only by the constructor.
Parameter _supply is consumed only by the constructor when setting totalSupply.
Local _UNI exists only inside ensure() for the whitelist comparison.
Local total is the unchecked product computed by the batchSend arithmetic unsafe operation.
Loop index i exists only inside the batchSend iteration.
Loop local _to exists only inside the batchSend iteration.
Local pair is the return value computed inside pairFor().
